title: Pan-Seared Norwegian Salmon with Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared Norwegian salmon served with a light and fluffy pilaf.
instructions: Rinse the salmon fillets and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the salmon with red pepper flakes and pepper.
Heat ultra light olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the salmon fillets to the skillet, skin side up (if they have skin).
Cook for 3-4 minutes or until the skin is crispy and golden brown.
Flip the salmon over and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes or until cooked through.
While the salmon is cooking, prepare the pilaf according to the package instructions.
Serve the pan-seared salmon on top of the pilaf.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
